verses.zh: 巴比伦王尼布甲尼撒从前掳到巴比伦之犹大省的人，现在他们的子孙从被掳到之地回耶路撒冷和犹大，各归本城。
verses.en: [NOTE:1] These are the people[NOTE:2] of the province who were going up,[NOTE:3] from the captives of the exile whom King Nebuchadnezzar of Babylon had forced into exile in Babylon. They returned to Jerusalem[NOTE:4] and Judah, each to his own city.
notes: The list of names and numbers in this chapter of Ezra has a parallel account in Neh 7:6-73. The fact that the two lists do not always agree in specific details suggests that various textual errors have crept into the accounts during the transmission process.
Heb “the sons of.”

The Hebrew term הָעֹלִים (haʿolim, “those who were going up” [Qal active participle]) refers to continual action in the past. Most translations render this as a simple past: “went up” (KJV), “came up” (RSV, ASV, NASB, NIV), “came” (NRSV). CEV paraphrases: “were on their way back.”
For location see Map5-B1; Map6-F3; Map7-E2; Map8-F2; Map10-B3; JP1-F4; JP2-F4; JP3-F4; JP4-F4.

verses.zh: 他们是同着所罗巴伯、耶书亚、尼希米、西莱雅、利来雅、末底改、必珊、米斯拔、比革瓦伊、利宏、巴拿回来的。
verses.en: They came with Zerubbabel, Jeshua, Nehemiah, Seraiah, Reelaiah, Mordecai, Bilshan, Mispar, Bigvai, Rehum, and Baanah. The number of Israelites[NOTE:1] was as follows:[NOTE:2]
notes: Heb “men of the people of Israel.”
The words “was as follows” are not in the Hebrew text but are used in the translation for clarity.

verses.zh: 以色列人民的数目记在下面：巴录的子孙二千一百七十二名；
verses.en: the descendants[NOTE:1] of Parosh: 2,172;
notes: Heb “the sons of.”

verses.zh: 示法提雅的子孙三百七十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Shephatiah: 372;

verses.zh: 亚拉的子孙七百七十五名；
verses.en: the descendants of Arah: 775;

verses.zh: 巴哈・摩押的后裔，就是耶书亚和约押的子孙二千八百一十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Pahath Moab (from the line[NOTE:1] of Jeshua and[NOTE:2] Joab): 2,812;
notes: Heb “to the sons of.” Cf. v. 40.
The MT reads יוֹאָב (yoʾav, “Joab”). However, syntax demands the reading וְיוֹאָב (veyoʾav, “and Joab”) which is reflected in the LXX and Syriac.

verses.zh: 以拦的子孙一千二百五十四名；
verses.en: the descendants of Elam: 1,254;

verses.zh: 萨土的子孙九百四十五名；
verses.en: the descendants of Zattu: 945;

verses.zh: 萨改的子孙七百六十名；
verses.en: the descendants of Zaccai: 760;

verses.zh: 巴尼的子孙六百四十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Bani: 642;

verses.zh: 比拜的子孙六百二十三名；
verses.en: the descendants of Bebai: 623;

verses.zh: 押甲的子孙一千二百二十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Azgad: 1,222;

verses.zh: 亚多尼干的子孙六百六十六名；
verses.en: the descendants of Adonikam: 666;

verses.zh: 比革瓦伊的子孙二千零五十六名；
verses.en: the descendants of Bigvai: 2,056;

verses.zh: 亚丁的子孙四百五十四名；
verses.en: the descendants of Adin: 454;

verses.zh: 亚特的后裔，就是希西家的子孙九十八名；
verses.en: the descendants of Ater (through[NOTE:1] Hezekiah): 98;
notes: Heb “to.” So also in vv. 36, 40.

verses.zh: 比赛的子孙三百二十三名；
verses.en: the descendants of Bezai: 323;

verses.zh: 约拉的子孙一百一十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Jorah: 112;

verses.zh: 哈顺的子孙二百二十三名；
verses.en: the descendants of Hashum: 223;

verses.zh: 吉罢珥人九十五名；
verses.en: the descendants of Gibbar: 95.

verses.zh: 伯利恒人一百二十三名；
verses.en: The men[NOTE:1] of Bethlehem:[NOTE:2] 123;
notes: The translation follows the suggestion in BHS and reads אַנְשֵׁי (ʾanshe, “the men of”) here rather than the reading בְּנֵי (bene, “the sons of”) found in the MT. So also in vv. 25, 26, 33, 34.
For location see Map5-B1; Map7-E2; Map8-E2; Map10-B4.

verses.zh: 尼陀法人五十六名；
verses.en: the men of Netophah: 56;

verses.zh: 亚拿突人一百二十八名；
verses.en: the men of Anathoth: 128;

verses.zh: 亚斯玛弗人四十二名；
verses.en: the men of the family[NOTE:1] of Azmaveth: 42;
notes: Heb “the men of the house of Azmaveth”; some regard בֵּית (bet, “house of”) as a part of the place name: NAB, NLT “Beth Azmaveth.”tc The translation follows the suggestion in BHS and reads אַנְשֵׁי בֵּית (ʾanshe bet, “men of the house of”) here rather than the reading בְּנֵי (bene, “the sons of”) found in the MT. And see H. G. M. Williamson, Ezra, Nehemiah (WBC), 25.

verses.zh: 基列・耶琳人、基非拉人、比录人共七百四十三名；
verses.en: the men of Kiriath Jearim,[NOTE:1] Kephirah and Beeroth: 743;
notes: The translation, with the support of many manuscripts, reads יְעָרִים (yeʿarim) here rather than the reading עָרִים (ʿarim) of the MT.

verses.zh: 拉玛人、迦巴人共六百二十一名；
verses.en: the men of Ramah and Geba: 621;

verses.zh: 默玛人一百二十二名；
verses.en: the men of Micmash: 122;

verses.zh: 伯特利人、艾人共二百二十三名；
verses.en: the men of Bethel[NOTE:1] and Ai: 223;
notes: For location see Map4-G4; Map5-C1; Map6-E3; Map7-D1; Map8-G3.

verses.zh: 尼波人五十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Nebo: 52;

verses.zh: 末必人一百五十六名；
verses.en: the descendants of Magbish: 156;

verses.zh: 别的以拦子孙一千二百五十四名；
verses.en: the descendants of the other Elam: 1,254;

verses.zh: 哈琳的子孙三百二十名；
verses.en: the descendants of Harim: 320;

verses.zh: 罗德人、哈第人、阿挪人共七百二十五名；
verses.en: the men of Lod, Hadid, and Ono: 725;

verses.zh: 耶利哥人三百四十五名；
verses.en: the men of Jericho:[NOTE:1] 345;
notes: For location see Map5-B2; Map6-E1; Map7-E1; Map8-E3; Map10-A2; Map11-A1.

verses.zh: 西拿人三千六百三十名。
verses.en: the descendants of Senaah: 3,630.

verses.zh: 祭司：耶书亚家耶大雅的子孙九百七十三名；
verses.en: The priests: the descendants of Jedaiah (through the family[NOTE:1] of Jeshua): 973;
notes: Heb “the house of.”

verses.zh: 音麦的子孙一千零五十二名；
verses.en: the descendants of Immer: 1,052;

verses.zh: 巴施户珥的子孙一千二百四十七名；
verses.en: the descendants of Pashhur: 1,247;

verses.zh: 哈琳的子孙一千零一十七名。
verses.en: the descendants of Harim: 1,017.

verses.zh: 利未人：何达威雅的后裔，就是耶书亚和甲篾的子孙七十四名。
verses.en: The Levites: the descendants of Jeshua and Kadmiel (through the line of Hodaviah): 74.

verses.zh: 歌唱的：亚萨的子孙一百二十八名。
verses.en: The singers: the descendants of Asaph: 128.

verses.zh: 守门的：沙龙的子孙、亚特的子孙、达们的子孙、亚谷的子孙、哈底大的子孙、朔拜的子孙，共一百三十九名。
verses.en: The gatekeepers:[NOTE:1] the descendants of Shallum, the descendants of Ater, the descendants of Talmon, the descendants of Akkub, the descendants of Hatita, and the descendants of Shobai: 139.
notes: Here it is preferable to delete the reading בְּנֵי (bene, “the sons of”) found in the MT.

verses.zh: 尼提宁（就是殿役）：西哈的子孙、哈苏巴的子孙、答巴俄的子孙、
verses.en: The temple servants: the descendants of Ziha, the descendants of Hasupha, the descendants of Tabbaoth,

verses.zh: 基绿的子孙、西亚的子孙、巴顿的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Keros, the descendants of Siaha, the descendants of Padon,

verses.zh: 利巴拿的子孙、哈迦巴的子孙、亚谷的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Lebanah, the descendants of Hagabah, the descendants of Akkub,

verses.zh: 哈甲的子孙、萨买的子孙、哈难的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Hagab, the descendants of Shalmai,[NOTE:1] the descendants of Hanan,
notes: The translation follows the Qere reading “Shalmai” (so KJV, NASB, NIV, NLT) rather than the MT Kethib “Shamlai” (so ASV, NAB, NRSV).

verses.zh: 吉德的子孙、迦哈的子孙、利亚雅的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Giddel, the descendants of Gahar, the descendants of Reaiah,

verses.zh: 利汛的子孙、尼哥大的子孙、迦散的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Rezin, the descendants of Nekoda, the descendants of Gazzam,

verses.zh: 乌撒的子孙、巴西亚的子孙、比赛的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Uzzah, the descendants of Paseah, the descendants of Besai,

verses.zh: 押拿的子孙、米乌宁的子孙、尼普心的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Asnah, the descendants of Meunim, the descendants of Nephussim,

verses.zh: 巴卜的子孙、哈古巴的子孙、哈忽的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Bakbuk, the descendants of Hakupha, the descendants of Harhur,

verses.zh: 巴洗律的子孙、米希大的子孙、哈沙的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Bazluth, the descendants of Mehida, the descendants of Harsha,

verses.zh: 巴柯的子孙、西西拉的子孙、答玛的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Barkos, the descendants of Sisera, the descendants of Temah,

verses.zh: 尼细亚的子孙、哈提法的子孙。
verses.en: the descendants of Neziah, and the descendants of Hatipha.

verses.zh: 所罗门仆人的后裔，就是琐太的子孙、琐斐列的子孙、比路大的子孙、
verses.en: The descendants of the servants of Solomon: the descendants of Sotai, the descendants of Hassophereth, the descendants of Peruda,

verses.zh: 雅拉的子孙、达昆的子孙、吉德的子孙、
verses.en: the descendants of Jaala, the descendants of Darkon, the descendants of Giddel,

verses.zh: 示法提雅的子孙、哈替的子孙、玻黑列・哈斯巴音的子孙、亚米的子孙。
verses.en: the descendants of Shephatiah, the descendants of Hattil, the descendants of Pokereth Hazzebaim, and the descendants of Ami.

verses.zh: 尼提宁和所罗门仆人的后裔共三百九十二名。
verses.en: All the temple servants and the descendants of the servants of Solomon: 392.

verses.zh: 从特・米拉、特・哈萨、基绿、押但、音麦上来的，不能指明他们的宗族谱系是以色列人不是；
verses.en: These are the ones that came up from Tel Melah, Tel Harsha, Kerub, Addon, and Immer (although they were unable to certify[NOTE:1] their family connection[NOTE:2] or their ancestry,[NOTE:3] as to whether they really were from Israel):
notes: Heb “relate.”
Heb “the house of their fathers.”
Heb “their seed.”

verses.zh: 他们是第来雅的子孙、多比雅的子孙、尼哥大的子孙，共六百五十二名。
verses.en: the descendants of Delaiah, the descendants of Tobiah, and the descendants of Nekoda: 652.

verses.zh: 祭司中，哈巴雅的子孙、哈哥斯的子孙、巴西莱的子孙；因为他们的先祖娶了基列人巴西莱的女儿为妻，所以起名叫巴西莱。
verses.en: And from among[NOTE:1] the priests: the descendants of Hobaiah, the descendants of Hakkoz, and the descendants of Barzillai (who had taken a wife from the daughters of Barzillai the Gileadite and was called by that[NOTE:2] name).
notes: The translation reads וּמִן (umin, “and from”) rather than the reading וּמִבְּנֵי (umibbeney, “and from the sons of”) found in the MT.
Heb “their.”

verses.zh: 这三家的人在族谱之中寻查自己的谱系，却寻不着，因此算为不洁，不准供祭司的职任。
verses.en: They[NOTE:1] searched for their records in the genealogical materials, but did not find them.[NOTE:2] They were therefore excluded[NOTE:3] from the priesthood.
notes: Heb “these.”
Heb “their records were searched for in the genealogical materials, but were not found.” This passive construction has been translated as active for stylistic reasons.
Heb “they were desecrated.”

verses.zh: 省长对他们说：「不可吃至圣的物，直到有用乌陵和土明决疑的祭司兴起来。」
verses.en: The governor[NOTE:1] instructed them not to eat any of the sacred food until there was a priest who could consult[NOTE:2] the Urim and Thummim.[NOTE:3]
notes: The Hebrew word תִּרְשָׁתָא (tirshataʾ) is an official title of the Persian governor in Judea, perhaps similar in meaning to “excellency” (BDB 1077 s.v.; HALOT 1798 s.v.; W. L. Holladay, Concise Hebrew and Aramaic Lexicon, 395).
Heb “to stand.”
The Urim and Thummim were two objects used to determine God’s will; there is no clear evidence of their size or shape, or the material from which they were made.

verses.zh: 会众共有四万二千三百六十名。
verses.en: The entire group numbered 42,360,[NOTE:1]
notes: The same total is given in Neh 7:66, but the numbers of people listed do not add up to this total; the list in vv. 3-60 is apparently selective, but it is not clear what the basis of the selectivity is.

verses.zh: 此外，还有他们的仆婢七千三百三十七名，又有歌唱的男女二百名。
verses.en: not counting[NOTE:1] their male and female servants, who numbered 7,337. They also had 200 male and female singers
notes: Heb “besides” or “in addition to.”

verses.zh: 他们有马七百三十六匹，骡子二百四十五匹，
verses.en: and 736 horses, 245 mules,

verses.zh: 骆驼四百三十五只，驴六千七百二十匹。
verses.en: 435 camels, and 6,720 donkeys.

verses.zh: 有些族长到了耶路撒冷耶和华殿的地方，便为　神的殿甘心献上礼物，要重新建造。
verses.en: When they came to the Lord’s temple in Jerusalem, some of the family leaders[NOTE:1]offered voluntary offerings for the temple of God in order to rebuild[NOTE:2] it on its site.
notes: Heb “the heads of the fathers.”
Heb “cause it to stand.”

verses.zh: 他们量力捐入工程库的金子六万一千达利克，银子五千弥拿，并祭司的礼服一百件。
verses.en: As they were able,[NOTE:1] they gave to the treasury for this work 61,000 drachmas[NOTE:2] of gold, 5,000 minas[NOTE:3] of silver, and 100 priestly robes.[NOTE:4]
notes: Heb “according to their strength.”

The meaning of the Hebrew word דַּרְכְּמוֹנִים (darkemonim, cf. Neh 7:69, 70, 71) is uncertain. It may be a Greek loanword meaning “drachmas” (the view adopted here and followed also by NAB, NASB, NIV84) or a Persian loanword “daric,” referring to a Persian gold coin (BDB 204 s.v. דַּרְכְּמוֹן; HALOT 232 s.v. נִים(וֹ)דַּרְכְּמֹ; cf. ASV, NIV11, NRSV). For further study, see R. de Vaux, Ancient Israel, 206-9.

The מָנִים (manim, cf. Neh 7:71, 72) is a measuring weight for valuable metals, equal to 1/60 of a talent or 60 shekels (BDB 584 s.v. מָנֶה; HALOT 599 s.v. מָנֶה). For further study, see R. de Vaux, Ancient Israel, 203-6.
Or “garments.”

verses.zh: 于是祭司、利未人、民中的一些人、歌唱的、守门的、尼提宁，并以色列众人，各住在自己的城里。
verses.en: The priests, the Levites, some of the people, the singers, the gatekeepers, and the temple servants lived in their towns, and all the rest of Israel lived in their towns.
